name: red-paper
description: Check attached documents for plagiarism and AI-written text with your Red Paper (checkplagiarism.ai) account.

interface.longDescription: RED PAPER checks uploaded documents for text similarity and AI-written content using your connected checkplagiarism.ai account. Upload PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT or RTF files, submit individual documents or batches of up to 10, and retrieve similarity reports, AI-text reports and originality certificates. Designed for authors, students, researchers, editors and publishers. Scans use your existing account credits.
capabilities: Check an attached document for plagiarism
Check up to 10 documents in one batch
Show scan status and report links
defaultPrompt: Check this document for plagiarism and AI-written text.
Check these documents together and show their similarity reports.
Show my remaining RED PAPER credits.

positive.expected_behavior: The attached file is submitted to the reviewer's Red Paper account. A Red Paper card appears with the file name, word count and a progress spinner; within 1-5 minutes it shows the similarity percentage and the AI-written text percentage with Plagiarism report, AI report and Certificate buttons. The reply gives the report link only; it never tries to fetch or attach the PDF.

positive.description: Check several attached documents in one batch
positive.prompt: Check these two files for plagiarism.
positive.expected_behavior: Both files are submitted in a single batch; credits are checked and charged once. One card lists each file with its own progress, then its own similarity percentage and Report / AI / Certificate buttons.

positive.description: Ask whether the scan is finished
positive.prompt: Is my plagiarism scan done yet?
positive.expected_behavior: The status of the most recent scan is fetched and the reply states either that it is still processing or the final similarity and AI percentages with the report link.
The reviewer account's recent reports are listed with file name, status, similarity percentage and report links.

positive.prompt: How many Red Paper credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: The connected account email and remaining credits are stated, with the credit rule (1 credit per 250 words, minimum 4 per document). No purchase or upgrade link is shown.

negative.description: Unsupported file type (attach a PNG image)
Request to buy credits inside ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy 100 Red Paper credits for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Scans use credits that already exist in the user's checkplagiarism.ai account; credits are managed on the website only.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: clearer name, description and starter prompts. No change to tools or behaviour.
